commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+10' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
90+8' The total number of attempts is 9:12.
90+4' The possession of the ball – 28:72.
90+3' The corner from Benie Traore (Nantes) is cleared away by the defence.
90+1' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remy Cabella (Lille) replaces Angel Gomes.
90+1' Substitution. Andrej Ilic (Lille) replaces Edon Zhegrova.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
90' Lucas Chevalier is being substituted because of an injury. Paulo Fonseca sends Vito Mannone (Lille) on the pitch.
86' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Chevalier (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

83' Benie Traore (Nantes) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
82' Benie Traore (Nantes) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
81' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) sees a yellow card from Eric Wattellier after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
80' Substitution. Tiago Santos leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alexsandro (Lille).
80' The referee signals a substitution. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
78' Tiago Santos (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) replacing Eray Comert.
76' A substitution has been made. Matthis Abline is replaced by Kader Bamba (Nantes).
76' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
74' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
73' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
71' Marcus Coco (Nantes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Eric Wattellier saw the whole situation.
69' It will be a substitution. Tino Kadewere (Nantes) is ready to enter the pitch as Pedro Chirivella walks off.
69' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
68' A quickly taken corner by Lille.
65' That was close by Matthis Abline (Nantes)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
65' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Benie Traore (Nantes), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
64' Benie Traore (Nantes) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lucas Chevalier reads it well and gathers the ball. Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
60' A yellow card for a tackle by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes). Eric Wattellier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Matthis Abline (Nantes) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
57' Dangerous play by Nicolas Cozza (Nantes). Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. Lille have a free kick.
57' Benie Traore (Nantes) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Eric Wattellier who sees an offensive foul.
54' 1 - 2 Matthis Abline (Nantes) has a great chance inside the box and fires the ball inside the left post.
52' Benie Traore (Nantes) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
52' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.

50' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Lucas Chevalier pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
49' Benie Traore (Nantes) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
48' Ismaily (Lille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' One of the players from Nantes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Antoine Kombouare decided to make a change. Florent Mollet (Nantes) is replaced by Benie Traore.
46' The game is over for Kelvin Amian (Nantes). Marcus Coco comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The game is interrupted. Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
44' Eric Wattellier rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Alban Lafont (Nantes).

42' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
41' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
40' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
38' One of the Lille players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
37' Nantes are ruled offside.
34' Tiago Santos (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' Today's referee Eric Wattellier rightly decides to book Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) for his harsh tackle.
33' The percentage of ball possession is – 24:76.
30' Florent Mollet (Nantes) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
29' Tiago Santos (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
26' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is flagged for offside.
26' Tiago Santos (Lille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' The resulting corner, taken by Edon Zhegrova (Lille), comes to nothing.
22' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) launches a cross from the corner, but Lucas Chevalier is alert to thwart the effort.

21' Tiago Santos (Lille) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
19' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Angel Gomes (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' 0 - 2 Goal! Angel Gomes manages to prod the ball to Jonathan David (Lille) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:2.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Jonathan David (Lille) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
8' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) prepares to take a corner kick.
7' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' The game is interrupted. Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
3' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
